title: First-Miss Courtesy on Missed Functional Capacity Evaluation Fees
content:
# First-miss courtesy

*Questions and answers — Functional Capacity Evaluation, Workers' Compensation Referral.*

**What is the first-miss courtesy?** An amount taken off the missed-evaluation fee when the miss is the first one. The first-miss courtesy is fifty dollars ($50.00) where the missed appointment is the only missed evaluation appointment reported to the adjuster on the referral and the worker rebooked the evaluation in the appointment series within seven (7) calendar days of the missed appointment; twenty-five dollars ($25.00) where it is the only missed appointment reported and the evaluation was not rebooked within seven days; and none otherwise.

**What does "the only missed appointment reported" mean?** Exactly one missed appointment — a late cancellation or a no-show — has been reported to the adjuster on the referral, at any time.

**What counts as rebooked within seven days?** The latest booking recorded in the Appointment Series funded by the referral was made on the day of the missed appointment or within the seven calendar days after it. A booking made before the missed appointment, or more than seven days after it, is not a rebooking within seven days.

**Combinations.**

| Missed appointments reported on the referral | Rebooked in the Appointment Series within 7 days | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| exactly 1 | yes | $50.00 |
| exactly 1 | no | $25.00 |
| 2 or more | any | none |

**Edges (hypothetical, one missed appointment reported).** Rebooked 7 days after the missed appointment: $50.00. Rebooked 8 days after: $25.00.
